headline_so_far: Fleet is -3.17% ($7,746.11 vs the $8,000 start), down $94.04 over the three days since the last supervisor run. 2026-07-29 was the fleet's worst and most explicable day: a hawkish Fed hold with three dissents FOR a hike sent the Dow down ~1,100 points, and simultaneously an Iranian missile attack on US forces plus US/Saudi strikes in Iraq put WTI up 4-6%. Those two facts split the fleet cleanly - commodity +7.34% on oil, stock -6.19% on 3x Nasdaq beta - and the spread between best and worst bot is now $270.19. Three structural findings outrank the P/L. (1) The stock bot at 814.07 is 64.07 from the R1 hard stop after a single -6.19% session, with its MA200 cushion down from 9.2% to 2.9%. (2) The hunter bot's churn is now measurably expensive: it sold USO at 119.65 on 07-28 and re-bought it at 129.02 on 07-29, paying 7.83% to get back into the position it already held, and the crypto bot round-trips coins in 13 minutes. (3) Operationally the fleet is much healthier - 110% of expected cycles in 24h versus 31% on 07-26 - but there is now a precisely repeating ~6h overnight blackout (368 min on 07-29/30, 367 min on 07-28/29) caused by the concurrency handoff, not by throttling. My own record: I was WRONG on the 07-27 oil call - the war premium re-armed instead of unwinding - and the alpha it appears to have earned is an artifact of an unreachable reference price.
